---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new problem, notebook, or capability for the platform
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
---

**What would you like added?**
A clear description of the capability or problem statement.

**Which phase/problem does this fit under?**
See `ROADMAP.md`'s "Problem roadmap" table — Phase 3 (Behavioral Intelligence), Phase 4
(Operational Risk Management), Phase 5 (Customer & Business Intelligence) are the open slots.
If this doesn't fit the existing 14-problem roadmap, say so and describe where it would go.

**Why does this matter for real credit risk practice?**
This platform's standing bar is that every problem answers a question a real risk committee
would actually ask (see `README.md`'s "Why This Matters" framing) — not just a leaderboard
metric. What real decision would this feature inform?

**Any relevant real-world reference?**
Regulatory standard, industry practice, or paper this should be modeled after, if applicable.
